items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever hear that Minetta brass band? I think Professor Minetta's uncle had it. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, they had a brass band.

ctx.x: Yeah. But they were two brass bands. They used to work all the time from the Orleans to the Algea. They had all the work. They used to do more. They had a lot of art fellas work down there. Parades. Art fellas would parade all the time. That's why Allen learned his son, his son boy, his boy there, how to play trumpet in a parade. He had a parade he played. He had his son right in there with him. Yeah. Yeah.
Did you ever hear that Minetta brass band? I think Professor Minetta's uncle had it.
Yeah, they had a brass band. Do you remember it? Well, that's the brand I'm talking about now. Did he ever tell you the name of the band?
